summary: Both of my v12 findings are genuinely repaired and I verified each independently rather than trusting the claim. The Codex v11 pin now binds the actually-frozen bytes and keeps the unreproducible 9c8fb1a0... on the record as priorUnreproduciblePin instead of erasing it; all fifteen pins reproduce, up from thirteen-with-one-failure. CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 is out of notFoldedThisSuccessor with both halves confirmed present in basedOn.method. The roster is exact, the remeasurement is exact at live HEAD - the dispatch's PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT allowance was never needed - and the carried text and DR-101 row remain byte-exact. Two ledger defects remain. First, the frozen Claude v11 REJECT still appears nowhere: it exists at 405bade0..., was frozen seven minutes before this subject was written, and every other generation from v4 on has both lanes pinned, so the timing defence I accepted at v12 no longer holds; its SHOULD-FIX was in fact folded here without credit and its advisory has no disposition. Second, and independently checkable, two honesty entries date DCIC-V7-A1's first recording to v9 when v9's bytes carry no codexv7.advisories key at all and v10's carry it - and the entry making that claim is DCIC-V11-A1, whose stated purpose is not conflating fold version with first-record version. Neither touches the contract's substance, which is clean.
